scope: Evidence-backed compiler profiles attached to candidate historical objects (translation units). The locked baseline stays the default; a non-default profile applies only through a reviewed assignment whose evidence is recorded here.

baseline.description: Locked conservative profile: /Oe register allocation, /Ol loop optimisation, /Ow aliasing across calls. Every admitted msc700 source was proven under it.

og.description: Baseline plus /Og global common-subexpression elimination and register write-through before calls. Discriminated by parked code-shape bodies; refuted for the win_SetColorFromObj object.

ogi.description: og plus /Oi intrinsic generation (inline memset/memcpy/strlen/strcat forms). Requires string-intrinsic fingerprints in the target.

ga.description: Baseline plus /GA Windows application prologue optimisation. Requires exported-prologue evidence; invariant on the admitted corpus.

og-ga.description: og plus /GA. Requires both kinds of evidence.

evidence_rules.minimality: A profile may only be assigned when its probe outcome improves on every parent profile (og, ga over baseline; ogi over og; og-ga over both og and ga); otherwise a parent is the minimal explanation.
evidence_rules.og: At least one member of the context reaches a strict GOOD member result under og but not under baseline (STRICT), or improves the search diagnostic without regressions (DIAGNOSTIC). Any admitted member of the context must be profile-invariant between baseline and og (invariance evidence).
evidence_rules.ogi: Rules for og plus a target containing string-intrinsic fingerprints (rep stosb/movsb, repne scasb) that the baseline candidate can only produce through library calls.
evidence_rules.ga: Original exported-function prologue evidence in the context that baseline cannot reproduce.
evidence_rules.refutation: An admitted member whose object changes under a profile refutes that profile for its context.

invariance.summary: 362 of 363 admitted msc700 sources compile to identical CODE bytes under baseline, og and ogi; all 363 are identical under ga. The admitted corpus therefore cannot identify the historical switches; only the discriminating members do.

assignments.reason: IsPillDead reaches STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_MEMBER only under /Og (probe); the pillar object (DoPillar..PillFoodTile, 16 shared selector-pool joins) shares one compiler profile; no admitted member of the context changes under /Og (invariance evidence).
SeparateFile reaches CONFIRMED_MEMBER only under /Og (probe); its object context is not yet located by selector-pool evidence, so the scope is the function's own component.

RecruitRed reaches a strict member result only under /Og (probe); the strategy/recruit object GetStrategy..GetRedDefendDir (25 shared-slot joins) shares one profile; admitted members are profile-invariant

SpecialTutorialInit reaches a strict member result only under /Og (probe); the file-dialog/load-save object OPENDLG..ClearLastFileName (10 shared-slot joins) shares one profile; SeparateFile next to it matched under og

INDIRECTDLGPROC (exported dialog procedure) reaches a strict member result only with /GA (probe): the exported-prologue evidence; the window framework core win_LoadAllWindows..win_DoProxMenu is one object; all admitted members are /GA-invariant
hanim_RemoveAnimSet reaches CONFIRMED_MEMBER only under /Og (probe); the hanim animation object (10 functions, shared slots BF74/BF76) shares one profile; hanim_MakeAnimSet admitted and /Og-invariant
win_DrawBitMapAtObj reaches CONFIRMED_MEMBER only under /Og (probe); its object is not yet joined to the ga-assigned framework core, so the scope is its own component

goStepNE and goStepSE reach full opcode alignment (103/103, 114/114) only under /Og (the far-address CSE into a stack temp reloaded via LES is /Og global CSE); the movement object simtwo:6EFE (55 shared-slot joins) shares one profile; its six admitted members are /Og-invariant

PlaceBlackQueen and PlaceRedQueen reach full opcode alignment with zero register differences (125/125 and 116/117, every non-fixup byte equal) only under /Og: their tunnel-loop range test repeats wobble + x and the update is x += wobble, and only global CSE folds the three occurrences into the AX temporary with an unused frame home that both targets show (enter 8 / enter 6); under the baseline profile the sum is recomputed (124/125, 115/119). DigOutRNest/DigOutBNest exact bodies (attempt06/attempt03) are og-invariant; the admitted members fracSIN, fracCOS and ExpAddFood are covered by the corpus invariance evidence. The nest-generation object simtwo:5AB0 shares one profile.
FixExitMapR reaches a strict member result only under /Og (probe); the FixExitMapB/R twin object shares one profile

FollowBoyDir reaches full opcode alignment with zero register differences (124/125, every non-fixup byte equal, the candidate only adds the trailing alignment nop) only under /Og: the abs if/else pair with dx/adx tracked in AX as memory locals, the constant-switch peephole and the direct memory compares of dx in the tail; under the baseline profile dx/dy take SI/DI and adx/ady go to memory (102/125, 5 register differences). The yard-simulation object simtwo:1378 shares one profile; its admitted members (InitSimYard unit, IsValidYard, InitGrassMap, MaintainSwarm, NotMowed) compile to identical objects under baseline and og (checked with the cached compiler service).

DoRecruitN and DoRandB reach STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_MEMBER only under /Og (probes); the /Og CSE temporaries (&LifeB[(x<<6)+y], &Tindex) explain every parked near-miss in the black-colony object; all admitted members are /Og-invariant
DoRandR reaches STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_MEMBER only under /Og (probe); the red-colony object mirrors the black one; admitted members are /Og-invariant

OverlayTileSet natural source (no pointer local) is STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_MEMBER under og/og-ga/ogi and NO_COMPLETE_MATCH under baseline/ga (56/70 opcodes, 216 bytes): the far-address home on the frame reloaded via LES is /Og global CSE. og is the minimal profile.

AntMenu natural source (far MeMode global, selection translated in place through cmd) aligns 83/83 opcodes at the target size 232 bytes under og/og-ga/ogi versus 76/83 (226 bytes) under baseline/ga; the only remaining difference is the frame immediate (ENTER 8,0 vs 4,0: one extra untouched 4-byte home). og is the minimal profile explaining the &MeMode frame home + LES reloads and the cross-jumped win_DoProxMenu call site.

MoveMyLife reaches STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_MEMBER only under /Og (probe: baseline keeps the defaulted plane in AX for the compare, /Og stores it to its frame home in both arms and compares memory, full opcode alignment 74/83 with only LINK far-call rewrites and fixups remaining); the IsClear3x3..TryMyDropOrLift terrain/life object (simone:5AD2-9C4A, one shared selector pool) shares one profile; admitted members (GetMap, IsThisEgg, IsThisPebble, IsNotBarrier, IsLessThanHole, IsSamePlane, DoMapUpdateDraw, EndTargetMode, EndLifeTransferMode, IsLiftable) are profile-invariant (IsLiftable probe: identical CONFIRMED_MEMBER under every catalog profile)
